text: Code reviews are a vital practice in software development. In a code review, another developer examines your work before it is added to the main project. This process is excellent for catching bugs early, as a fresh pair of eyes can spot logic errors or small mistakes that the original writer missed. Fixing these issues at this stage is much cheaper than discovering them later in production. Beyond finding problems, reviews are a powerful tool for knowledge sharing. Junior developers learn new techniques, while seniors can offer guidance and see how others solve problems. This regular exchange builds a stronger, more consistent team, ensuring that overall code quality remains high.
